description_en: Queries the historical transcoding task information of an audio or video file by its ID. This operation does not return specific job details
description_zh: 调用本接口根据音视频ID查询音视频历史转码任务信息，本接口不返回具体的作业信息
name: ListTranscodeTask

parameters.help_en:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
For audio or video files uploaded in the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the ID.
Obtain the video ID from the VideoId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
After the audio or video file is uploaded, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the VideoId value in the response
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time, which must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间（需晚于开始时间）。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 查询页数据大小，传入此参数，立刻设置返回数据每页显示的条数。最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Specify this parameter to return data starting from the specified page. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的当前页码。传入此参数，可指定查询数据从第几页开始返回。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

TranscodeTaskList.description_en: The list of transcoding task information

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was complete. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CompleteTime.description_zh: 转码任务完成时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the transcoding task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 转码任务创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

TaskStatus.description_en:
The status of the transcoding task.

Processing: in progress.
Partial: partially completed.
CompleteAllSucc: all transcoding jobs are complete and successful.
CompleteAllFail: all transcoding jobs are complete but all failed. If the source file has issues, no transcoding jobs are initiated and the entire transcoding task fails.
CompletePartialSucc: all transcoding jobs are complete but only some are successful
TaskStatus.description_zh:
转码任务状态。

Processing：处理中。
Partial：部分转码完成。
CompleteAllSucc：全部处理完成，且全部转码成功。
CompleteAllFail：全部处理完成，且全部转码失败，如果源片有问题，则不会发起任何转码作业，整个转码任务失败。
CompletePartialSucc：全部转码完成，但仅部分转码成功

TranscodeTemplateGroupId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group used for transcoding

Trigger.description_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

Auto: automatically triggered after a video is uploaded.
Manual: triggered by calling the SubmitTranscodeJobs operation
Trigger.description_zh:
触发类型。取值：

Auto：上传视频，自动触发。
Manual：SubmitTranscodeJobs接口触发
